nodes.title: Measures of location – mean, median, mode. Calculation of mean, mode and median, range and interquartile range will not be the direct focus of examination questions. Students will be expected to draw simple inferences and give interpretations to measures of location and dispersion. Significance tests will not be expected. Data may be discrete, continuous, grouped or ungrouped. Understanding and use of coding.

nodes.title: Discrete random variables
Discrete random variables

The Normal distribution including the mean, variance and use of tables of the cumulative distribution function. Knowledge of the shape and the symmetry of the distribution is required. Knowledge of the probability density function is not required. Derivation of the mean, variance and cumulative distribution function is not required. Interpolation is not necessary. Questions may involve the solution of simultaneous equations.
